death.dontstarve.ghost: %s has died. Their spirit lingers on the island...
message.dontstarve.ghost_no_touch: Your ghostly hands pass through your belongings.
message.dontstarve.wipe_start: All survivors have perished! The island collapses in %s seconds — find a way back, or start anew.
message.dontstarve.wipe_cancelled: A living soul walks the island again — the collapse is averted.
message.dontstarve.wipe_done: The old island is lost. A new island has risen.
message.dontstarve.effigy_hungry: The effigy hungers for blood. Only the living can feed it.
message.dontstarve.effigy_taken: This effigy already smells of %s's blood.
message.dontstarve.effigy_already: Your blood already binds this effigy.
message.dontstarve.effigy_attuned: You offer blood to the effigy. It will call you back.
message.dontstarve.effigy_revived: %s has clawed their way back from the beyond.
message.dontstarve.reviver_used: %1$s presses a Telltale Heart to %2$s — it beats again!
message.dontstarve.skyportal_needs_idol: The frame is cold. A Moon Rock Idol would wake it.
message.dontstarve.skyportal_lit: The idol melts into starlight. The sky portal is open.
message.dontstarve.escaped: %s came back from the islands through a sky portal.
message.dontstarve.hound_warning: You hear distant howling... something is coming.
message.dontstarve.run_lost: While you were away, your island collapsed. You wake up back home.
death.attack.dontstarve.darkness: %1$s was taken by something in the dark
death.attack.dontstarve.darkness.player: %1$s was taken by something in the dark while fighting %2$s
